messages:
maya: Quick planning: Customer-Alpha wants a tight canary for observability (per-route cost + trace hooks + error grouping). Need launch gates and a fallback. 
aj: MVP: sampled per-route+model cost estimates (UI tag 'estimated') + minimal span tags (route_id) scoped to canary region. Full billing later.
frank: Perf risk: extra span attrs can increase p95. I'll bench. Gate p95 delta at 5%.
denise: Customer requirement: model+route split for beta; dataset-level later. Must run canary in their dedicated region (no telemetry export).
samira: UI: show sampled badge + 95% CI, and region toggle. Placeholder widgets ready.
elena: Sampling plan: adaptive tiers by QPS (0.5/1/5%) so low-volume routes get enough samples.
maya: Acceptance gates: p95 <5% regression; estimator within 20% for top 80% traffic; security signoff for canary. Fallback: disable traces, keep estimates.
aj: Tasks: span schema PR (route_id), dataplane propagation. target 3 days.
frank: Perf microbench in 5 days. If overhead >3us/token, reduce sampling for non-critical routes.
denise: I'll confirm customer's canary region + legal today.
infra-bot: Deploy notice: runtime-kernel v2.14 rolling in 36h; will post perf metrics.
maya: Action owners ack?
aj: ack
frank: ack
samira: ack
elena: ack
denise: ack
maya: thanks. Next sync 48h after kernel rollout. Ping earlier if blocked.
